as_told.title: Mysterious man with 'googly eyes' who quizzed Drumm about the Serapeum and then vanished

plain: On his first trip to Egypt in 2017, Geoffrey Drumm, who says an alien gave him the true purpose of the pyramids, sat down to dinner at a hotel with a new friend whose "big bulbous eyes" were "like chameleon," seeming to move independently of each other. Drumm tells Michels the man quizzed him about the Serapeum, an ancient underground site in Egypt, and that when Drumm later tried to message him he "just kind of like disappeared in thin air."
